scripts.build:mcp: tsup src/mastra/stdio.ts --format esm,cjs --no-splitting --dts && echo '#!/usr/bin/env node' | cat - dist/stdio.mjs > temp && mv temp dist/stdio.mjs && chmod +x dist/stdio.mjs
scripts.build:http: tsup src/mastra/http.ts --format esm,cjs --no-splitting --dts && echo '#!/usr/bin/env node' | cat - dist/http.mjs > temp && mv temp dist/http.mjs && chmod +x dist/http.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:mcp && npm run build:http
